starting-off-attempting-to-rescue-a-dog.text: You have nowhere to send this lost dog...

starting-off-talking-to-chase.player: Do you have any dogs up for adoption?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: Welcome to our dog shelter! I'm Talia and I run it alongside my husband, Chase.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: You don't seem to have many dogs. Where are the rest?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: I wish I could tell you they'd all been adopted... but I'd be lying to myself.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: So they were never here to begin with?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: We're trying. The monks from the Monastery believe in our cause. That's why they granted us this land.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: But belief, sadly, won't help keep us open.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: What would you need to keep the shelter open?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: We need more strays to rescue. If people know they can find a companion here, they'll come.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: Can't you go out to look for strays then?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: It can take one of us hours just to coerce a puppy out of hiding.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Chase
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: And the shelter doesn't run itself.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: By the time we got back, we'd still need to clean the kennels, feed the dogs we do have, repair the fences...

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: Plus, there was no one to keep the cats and dogs separate.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.player: I thought this was a dog shelter?

starting-off-talking-to-talia.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: What we really need is someone worldly who can bring strays back for us.
If the player does not meet the quest's requirements:

steps.player: Sounds like it. No luck in finding anyone then?

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Sadly not.

starting-off-talking-to-talia.text: If the player meets the quest's requirements:

steps.prompt: Start the A Ruff Situation quest?

steps.player: Lucky for you, I enjoy wandering.

steps.speaker: Chase
steps.text: I can smell it.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: So you'll help us out?

steps.player: I'd be happy to. Any ideas where I could start?

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: We've met so many people that might be able to...

steps.speaker: Chase
steps.text: Gertrude.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Yes, Gertrude! She was a great help with the cats.

steps.speaker: Chase
steps.text: Not much for dogs.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Right, but I'm sure she can point you in the right direction. You'll find her house near the western entrance to Varrock.
If the player hasn't completed Gertrude's Cat:

steps.player: Sure, I can check in with her.

steps.text: If the player has completed Gertrude's Cat:

steps.player: Excellent idea. I've helped her out before. I can check in with her.

steps.speaker: Talia
steps.text: Wonderful! Good luck!

steps.player: I'm afraid I can't help you at the moment.

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.text: Adventurer, have you come to help us?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.player: What did you need of me again?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.text: We need someone worldly to bring back stray dogs for us. Would you be willing to help us?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-again.prompt: Start the A Ruff Situation quest?

starting-off-talking-to-chase-after-star.player: How are the dogs doing? Keeping them healthy?
Man of few words I see.

starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.player: Who did you want me to check in with?

starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.text: Yes, she may know of some dogs that need help.

starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.speaker: Talia
starting-off-talking-to-talia-after-star.text: You'll pass her house on the way into Varrock from here, just outside the western entrance to the city.

starting-off-trying-to-rescue-other-stra.player: I should finish helping Talia with my current task before bringing back another stray.

steps.text: If Gertrude's Cat has been completed:

steps.player: Hello there, Gertrude.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Hello, adventurer! How can I help you today?

steps.player: I've come to ask a favour, if you don't mind?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Of course, anything for the hero who returned Fluffs to me.

steps.player: Talia sent me to you. She said you helped them with their dog shelter?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: It's just a dog shelter now? I don't blame them... They had trouble keeping the cats and dogs separate. How have they been getting on?

steps.player: Not well. They barely have any dogs in for adoption.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Oh dear... I suppose that's why you're here?

steps.player: Precisely! They thought you might know of some dogs in the city I could rescue.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, it would be nice for someone to do something about those mangy stray dogs you see in Varrock.

steps.player: I wouldn't call them mangy... They just need some love.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: They're covered in fleas and they're everywhere. They always beg for food when I walk through the city.

steps.player: Sounds like the kind of rescue Talia would be looking for...

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I'd be happy to see them go. I always see them near the west entrance to the city.

steps.player: I'll start my search there then. You've been a great help!

steps.text: If Gertrude's Cat hasn't been completed:

steps.player: Hello, are you Gertrude by chance?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Yes, I am. However, I'm in no mood to entertain guests today.

steps.player: I just have a few questions to ask. I've been told you're good with animals.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, I have a missing cat, if that's what you mean...

steps.player: Talia sent me to you. She said you helped them with their dog shelter?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: It's just a dog shelter now? I don't blame them... They had trouble keeping the cats and dogs separate. How have they been getting on?

steps.player: Not well. They barely have any dogs in for adoption.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Oh dear... I suppose that's why you're here?

steps.player: Precisely! They thought you might know of some dogs in the city I could rescue.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, it would be nice for someone to do something about those mangy stray dogs you see in Varrock.

steps.player: I wouldn't call them mangy... They just need some love.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: They're covered in fleas and they're everywhere. They always beg for food when I walk through the city.

steps.player: Sounds like the kind of rescue Talia would be looking for...

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I'd be happy to see them go. I always see them near the west entrance to the city.

steps.player: I'll start my search there then. You've been a great help!

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: If only someone cared about my Fluffs as much as those mutts...

steps.player: Where did you say you saw some stray dogs again?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Just head to the west entrance of Varrock. I'm sure you'll run into one before long.

gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.text: Excellent! Was she able to point you in the right direction?

gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.player: She mentioned there are some stray dogs in Varrock that might need help.

gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
gertrude-talking-to-talia-again.text: Great! You should head in that direction and take a look around!

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: I have no idea. She just started barking at me.

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.player: Something has her upset. Has she ever been like this before?

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: No, normally she's very friendly, although we haven't seen her for a few weeks...

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.player: Whatever it is, she is being very persistent.

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: Maybe she wants one of us to follow her. I can't leave my post. Could you go?

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.player: Hmm... This is the kind of situation Talia would have me intervene with...
Of course I can! Where did you want to go, girl?

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.speaker: Varrock Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-or-intera.text: You'd better be quick! She's already on the move.

stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-again.speaker: Varrock Guard
stray-dog-talking-to-the-guard-again.text: You'd better be quick! She's already on the move.

stray-dog-interacting-with-the-dog.player: Something is wrong. I should follow her and find out what she wants.

stray-dog-upon-approaching-the-stray-dog.text: The stray dog moves closer towards its home.

at-the-dog-s-house-interacting-with-the-.player: I've followed you here like you wanted. What do you want to show me?

at-the-dog-s-house-interacting-with-the-.text: The stray dog indicates towards her makeshift den.

at-the-dog-s-house-inspecting-the-torn-n.text: You inspect the scraps on the floor...
They've been ripped up by something with small teeth.

at-the-dog-s-house-inspecting-the-chewed.text: You notice some chew marks on the corner.

at-the-dog-s-house-inspecting-the-rough-.text: You notice a large indentation and three smaller ones.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: I think I'm starting to understand what's got you so upset.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.text: The stray dog looks at you with a sad look in her eye.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: It appears some puppies were playing here at one point...

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.text: The stray dog nods in agreement.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: But they're gone now and you don't seem too happy about it.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.text: The stray dog cocks her head and begins to sniff the air.

at-the-dog-s-house-after-inspecting-all-.player: What's wrong? Have you caught their scent?

at-the-dog-s-house-interacting-with-the-.player: She must have caught the scent of her puppies. I should follow her.

at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.player: I figured out what's wrong with the stray dog!
After looking around her den, I think she's had some puppies.

at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.text: That explains why she went missing for so long. Are the puppies still there?

at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
at-the-dog-s-house-talking-to-the-guard.text: Then why are you here talking to me. Go help her find them!

at-the-dog-s-house-upon-entering-the-ban.speaker: Banker
at-the-dog-s-house-upon-entering-the-ban.text: Oi, get that mutt out of my bank!

at-the-dog-s-house-upon-approaching-the-.speaker: Guard
at-the-dog-s-house-upon-approaching-the-.text: No mutts allowed in the Grand Exchange! Keep that dog away.

cutscene.player: Hey, is that one of your puppies?

cutscene.text: The stray puppy approaches its mother, followed by a goblin.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.player: Hang on, let me take something out of my pockets first.

cutscene.player: Yes of course, let's get you out of danger first, little guy.

cutscene.text: The player picks up the stray puppy.

cutscene-after-the-cutscene.player: We arrived at the right time.
Are there any more puppies we need to find?

cutscene-after-the-cutscene.text: If the player does not have a follower:

steps.text: The stray dog barks in the direction the goblin ran off in.

steps.player: Let's go find them then! Follow me!

cutscene-after-the-cutscene.text: If the player currently has a follower:

steps.text: The stray dog can't follow you at the moment.

cutscene-interacting-with-the-stray-dog.player: Do you remember which way the goblins went?

cutscene-interacting-with-the-stray-dog.text: The stray dog sniffs the air...
The stray dog barks in the direction of the scent.

cutscene-dismissing-the-stray-dog.player: I need to do something else. Can you wait for me at your den?

cutscene-talking-to-the-guard-again.text: With the stray dog following you:

steps.text: The guard is standing watch and doesn't have time to chat.

cutscene-talking-to-the-guard-again.text: Without the stray dog following you:

steps.player: Has the stray dog come back this way? I can't find her.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: I think I saw her heading towards her den, north of the Apothecary.

cutscene-going-too-far-from-varrock-with.text: The stray dog won't go too far from her den. She will wait for you there.

cutscene-talking-to-talia-again.player: I found a stray dog in Varrock, but her puppies have gone missing.

cutscene-talking-to-talia-again.speaker: Talia
cutscene-talking-to-talia-again.text: Oh dear! You must help her! Please, return to her at once!

cutscene-returning-to-the-dog-after-leav.player: My apologies, I'm ready to continue the search for your puppies.

cutscene-interacting-with-the-goblins-wi.player: I should have the stray dog with me before I interrupt these goblins.

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: What mean Picklenose lose other dog?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Ooh, big big! Toetaller understand now.

goblins.player: Ahem!

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: It not big as Nosorog... Picklenose lie.

goblins.player: It bigger before.
Picklenose not lie! Dog bigger before.
Excuse me!

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Human rude. Goblins busy. Speak quick.

goblins.player: Why did you steal these puppies? You need to give them back.

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Sorry, human. We have big plan. Keep village safe.

goblins.player: Puppies will keep your village safe?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Very silly. Puppy too weak. We wait 'till puppy big, strong.

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Big, strong, scary dog keep village safe.

goblins.player: You're just going to wait here till the puppy is fully grown?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Yes. Not take long Toetaller think.

goblins.player: I'm afraid puppies don't work like that.
You know you have to feed dogs to keep them alive?
They also have a lot of energy they need to burn off.
You need to play with them, take them for walks...
I wouldn't expect a dog to sit and guard your village all day either.
It's a dog. It needs attention and caring for. It won't just sit still for hours.
Maybe a guard dog isn't the best idea?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: No, Toetaller still want guard dog. We make this one guard dog without all that.

goblins.player: If you don't feed it, it will die.
Oh, here we go...

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Human find goblins dog that no need all that... extra stuff, then goblins give human this useless dog.

goblins.player: I don't think a dog like that exists...
Wait, wait! Could I make you something?
Maybe I could make something with some fur...?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Remember dog need be big... huge!

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Yes, huge and scary. Defend village from outsiders.

goblins.player: ... Then I suppose I'd need to stuff it with something, maybe grain...?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Dog intimidate invaders, save goblin lives.

goblins.speaker: Picklenose
goblins.text: Human even listen to goblins now?

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: More like Picklenose not worth listening to.

goblins.player: ... Then a needle and thread to put it together...
Okay, I think I can make something better for you.

goblins.speaker: Toetaller
goblins.text: Human be quick. Goblins low attention span.

goblins-interacting-with-the-goblins-aga.player: I should have the stray dog with me before I talk to these goblins again.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.speaker: Picklenose
goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: You got big dog for goblins?

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.player: Not yet. Do you remember what I needed?

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.speaker: Toetaller
goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human useless. You came up with idea.

steps.player: Yes.
No.
Yes.
No.

steps.player: Yes.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human not got needle or costume needle:

steps.player: No.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human got thread or costume needle:

steps.player: Yes.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human not got thread or costume needle:

steps.player: No.

steps.speaker: Picklenose
steps.text: Human go finish shopping trip then.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: If the player has all the items:

steps.speaker: Picklenose
steps.text: Human got everything human need then. Waste goblin time by asking. Goblin time very important, can't waste.

goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.speaker: Toetaller
goblins-talking-to-the-goblins-again-or-.text: Human not survive long in village if goblin.

stuffed-dog-trying-to-make-the-stuffed-d.text: You do not have the required items to make a stuffed dog. You need grain, some fur, a needle and some thread.

steps.text: You create a stuffed dog. It will probably convince the goblins.

stuffed-dog-crafting-a-stuffed-dog-with-.prompt: Which item would you like to craft?

stuffed-dog-trying-to-craft-another-stuf.text: You already have a stuffed dog.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: I should have the stray dog with me before I talk to these goblins again.
Has the stray dog come this way? I can't find her.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Guard
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: No, I haven't seen her. What was the last thing you did with her?

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: Her puppies were stolen by some goblins west of the Cooks' Guild. I was trying to get them back.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Guard
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: I doubt she'd leave her puppies alone with the goblins. I bet she's gone back there to keep them safe.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Human has returned.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Finally. Picklenose bored waiting.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Toetaller no see huge dog?

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Human own idea fail?

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: No no, I have them right here.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: You show the goblins the stuffed dog.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: That's big dog...

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Village never attacked again with this dog guarding.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Toetaller accept trade, no takesies backsies. Human promise.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Good. Toetaller no want human show up to village and cry in front of Generals.
You give the goblins the stuffed dog.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Goblins amazed at size of big dog.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Very big.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Toetaller have idea.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: General Toetaller and General Picklenose have good ring to them.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Nobody stop us with big dog on our side.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Toetaller
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Human, you do good. Goblins return to village heroes.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Picklenose
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: You allowed visit village, see dog if want.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: Oh, that's very kind of you. Thank you.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: The goblins leave.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: They're finally gone. Come with us, little guy. We'll keep you safe.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Stray puppy
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Yop yop!
The player picks up the stray puppy.
If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.text: You don't have enough inventory space to pick up the stray puppy.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: I managed to rescue some stray puppies!

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Talia
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: That's wonderful news. Do you think they'd like to join us at the shelter?

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.player: I think so. They'd be safe here, right?

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Chase
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: As long as I'm around.

back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.speaker: Talia
back-to-the-goblins-with-the-stuffed-dog.text: Of course! Please, bring them over.

looking-for-the-third-puppy.player: Great! That's two puppies saved. Is that all of them?
I'm inclined to believe that's a no. Any clue where they could be?

looking-for-the-third-puppy.text: The stray dog sniffs the air...

looking-for-the-third-puppy-talking-to-t.player: She must have caught the scent of her puppies. I should follow her.

looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.speaker: Outlaw
looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.text: A little mangy mutt. Can we keep 'em?
The outlaws approach the stray puppy.

looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.speaker: Outlaw
looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.text: For now, but don't get too attached. Heard tale some folk down in Morytania buy 'em when they're fully grown.
The outlaws continue approaching the stray puppy.

looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.speaker: Outlaw
looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.text: Not for us to know. All I care about is the runes they'll give us.

looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.speaker: Outlaw
looking-for-the-third-puppy-cutscene.text: Runes? We can sell them for a good bit of coin.
